offers.title: Mastercard | Fast Track
offers.longDesc:
SOLO Mastercard World Elite cardholders have the opportunity to use the Dragon Pass Fast Track service at more than 100 airports worldwide


The Fast Track service allows you to pass through airport security control without waiting in line, with the gate opening automatically for you


Please see the Fast Track service terms according to SOLO packages:


 • SOLO X and SOLO Premium – 10 free uses


 • SOLO Club – unlimited use, with up to 5 guests per visit and a maximum of 10 guests per year


How to use the service:


 • Register in the Mastercard Travel Pass (MTP) mobile app (IOS, Android) or on the website

• To book a Fast Track pass, select the airport, number of travelers, and your preferred time slot

• Receive your Fast Track pass in the app or by email and proceed to the Fast Track zone in your terminal

• Present your Fast Track pass to gain access


Please note:

The Mastercard Travel Pass (MTP) app will gradually replace the Mastercard Travel Experiences (MTE) app


For existing users:

Existing users will be able to use the MTE app until July 21, 2026, after which access to the service will be available through the MTP app. You can log in using your existing credentials; re-registration is not required


For new users:

Starting from May 12, 2026, MTE will no longer accept new registrations. New users will be able to access the Fast Track service through the MTP app

offers.title: Lounge Key
offers.longDesc:
For SOLO Mastercard World Elite cardholders, you have the opportunity to use LoungeKey services in more than 1,200 airports worldwide.

Using LoungeKey is easy:

• Open the website or the LoungeKey app

App Store

Google Play

• Check information about free visits

• Check if there is a LoungeKey in the given airport

• Visit the lounge

• Present your physical bank and boarding card or QR code received from the website/app


Get familiar with the criteria for using LoungeKey for free according to your package:

• SOLO X – you have the opportunity to visit lounges for free up to 6 times per year, if, before each visit, you spend at least 1,000 GEL in total with the SOLO X Mastercard World Elite card within the previous 35 days

• SOLO Premium – you have the opportunity to visit lounges for free up to 10 times per year, if, before each visit, you spend at least 1,500 GEL in total with the SOLO Premium Mastercard World Elite card within the previous 35 days

• SOLO Club - regardless of the payment, you will enjoy unlimited free access to the lounges. In addition, you have the opportunity to allow your accompanying guests (max. 5 guests per visit, total 10 guests per year) to use the LoungeKey service for free.


A 37-day Welcome Period will apply for SOLO Mastercard World Elite cardholders, starting from June 4, 2025. For cards issued from June 4, 2025, the Welcome Period will be counted from the card activation date. During the Welcome Period, you will use lounge services for free, regardless of meeting the criteria. Please note that visits used during the Welcome Period will be deducted from the total number of visits.


The following transactions are not included in the criteria:

• Payments made on the day of departure and within 7 days prior to the flight date

• Cash withdrawal operations

• P2P transfer operations

• Operations related to computer and mobile games

• Operations related to commission fee payments


Please review the Frequently Asked Questions
